rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping production robotics systems (drones at Skycatch, autonomous tractors at Agtonomy) and is now focused on real-time infrastructure as a critical blocker for the industry—a gap he's building into LiveKit. E, as an educator and technology professional, may find value in understanding how production robotics teams actually operate, or could offer perspective on communicating complex autonomous systems to broader audiences.
intro_message: David Chen, meet E Agor — David's spent a decade shipping autonomous systems to production and is now solving real-time infrastructure challenges at LiveKit; E's background in education and technology could offer a useful outside perspective on the robotics space.
